title: 笔 · pen, brush, a stroke, writing
desc: Bamboo over hair: the bamboo-handled writing brush drawn as a character. From the implement grow the act of writing, the strokes that build a glyph, and a measure word for sums and deals.

title: 表 · surface, to express, a table, a watch
desc: The garment radical worn on the outside: 表 runs from the outer surface of things to showing feeling, the chart on a page, and the watch on a wrist.

title: 才 · talent, ability, only-then, not until
desc: A sprout breaking ground, the first sign of growth. From that image grow two threads: talent as raw promise, and the adverb 才 that marks something later, harder, or smaller than expected.

title: 当 · to be, just at, ought; (dàng) appropriate, to treat as
desc: A high-frequency polyphone with two readings. As dāng it means to serve as, to be at a given time or place, and ought to; as dàng it means appropriate, to treat something as, and to pawn. The tone tells you which sense is in play.

title: 定 · to fix, settle, decide, surely
desc: A settling element coming to rest under a roof. From that image of a thing made still and fixed in place grows the whole field of 定: to decide, to set, the fixed and stable, the certain and sure.

title: 而 · and, but, yet (a classical connective)
desc: A pictograph of a beard, borrowed early as one of the busiest function words in literary Chinese. 而 links clause to clause as and, but, or yet, ties manner to verb, and frames set phrases like 而且 and 而已.

title: 发 · to send out, to develop, hair
desc: One simplified glyph that swallowed two traditional characters. 发 carries the fa reading of sending, emitting, and developing (traditional 發) and the fa reading of hair on the head (traditional 髮).

title: 公 · public, fair, common, a duke, male
desc: A line dividing away the private self. From that image grow everything held in common, every fair dealing, the metric measures, and the elder male: public, impartial, official, and a duke.

title: 故 · reason; old; deliberately; therefore
desc: 故 binds five senses into one glyph: cause, the old and former, deliberateness, the literary "hence," and the deceased. The thread is a settled cause behind what is done or what has passed.

title: 合 · to join, combine, suit, close
desc: A lid closing down over the mouth of a vessel. From that image of two parts meeting and fitting grows the whole field of joining, suiting, closing, and adding up into a whole.

title: 画 · to draw, a painting, a stroke
desc: A hand with a brush drawing the boundaries of a field. From that image grows the whole world of pictures: to paint, a painting, and the single stroke of a character.

title: 件 · item, piece, measure word
desc: The measure word for matters, garments, and gifts, and the character behind documents, parts, and cases.

title: 节 · joint, node, festival, to economize
desc: A bamboo joint, the segment between the knots. From that node grows everything that comes in sections: the joint of a limb, the chapter of a book, the festival that knots the calendar, and the restraint that keeps a thing within bounds.

title: 句 · sentence, phrase, a unit of speech
desc: A wrapping line drawn over a mouth: speech bundled into a single unit. From that image grows the sentence, the line of verse, and the measure word that counts the remarks we say.

title: 乐 · happy, joyful (lè); music (yuè)
desc: A picture of a wooden frame strung with silk and a drum, an early musical instrument. The simplified 乐 carries two readings: yuè for music, the original sense, and lè for joy, the happiness that music gives.

title: 力 · strength, power, force, effort
desc: A picture of a plough or a flexed sinew, the image of bodily exertion. From that one shape grows everything pushed by force: raw strength, the capacity to do, and the effort poured into a task.

title: 量 · quantity, capacity; to measure
desc: 商量 shangliang, to discuss, is literally to measure something out together: the act of weighing it between two minds before anyone decides.

title: 论 · to discuss, a theory or treatise
desc: Reasoned speech put in order: the verb for discussing, debating, and commenting, and the noun for a theory, a view, or a treatise. Also Lun in the title of the Analects.

title: 平 · flat, level, even, peaceful, ordinary
desc: A pictograph of something level and balanced. From that flat surface grows a wide field of meaning: the even and the smooth, the equal and the fair, the calm and the peaceful, and the plain and ordinary.

title: 清 · clear, clean, pure, quiet
desc: Water beside the color of new growth. The character that names limpid water, distinct speech, a clean reputation, a settled account, and a cool quiet evening.
